phases.name: Setup
phases.focus: Morning weigh-ins on the Wyze scale, bike or walk every day.

phases.name: Rebuild
phases.focus: Weigh in Mon, Wed, Fri, Sun mornings. One hard bike session on Tuesday. Hit the step target with bike credit.

phases.name: Build
phases.focus: Two hard bike sessions. Calories follow the Diet Coach Log plateau rule. Hold through the holidays.

phases.name: Push
phases.focus: Full volume. Every week counts toward 78 kg.

Wed.session: Easy bike 30 min, or walk if dry

Thu.session: Easy bike 30 min at lunch + strength

Fri.session: Easy bike 30 min, or walk if dry

Sun.session: Long walk if dry, else easy bike 45 min. Waist measure

rules: Weigh in on the Wyze scale after the bathroom, before food, water or coffee. Mon, Wed, Fri, Sun.
Calories, protein and the plateau call follow the Diet Coach Log.
Bike counts: every bike minute earns 100 steps toward the daily target.
Behind pace at 3 PM: 20 to 30 min easy bike after dinner. No debate.
Readiness red (HRV low, sleep under 6 h, or body battery peak under 50): swap the hard session for easy, move it to tomorrow.
nutrition_source: Diet Coach Log (claude.ai artifact). Calories and the plateau rule are set there, not here.
